component.name: FeynosRGB
component.summary: Control RGB lighting with effects, music sync and temperature colors

description.p: FeynosRGB is a standalone RGB lighting controller for Linux. It talks to your hardware directly, with no vendor software or background services required.

ul.li: ASUS Aura USB motherboards: onboard LEDs, RGB and ARGB headers
Live effects: rainbow wave, gradient, comet, twinkle, fire and more
Audio-reactive spectrum, beat pulse and VU meter
Profiles, tray icon, start at login and command line control
